Mutter and Blue Prince among winners at Gamescom Dev Awards 2026
Six winners were crowned in Cologne.
Chris Kerr
,
Senior Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 24, 2026
1 Min Read
Image via DeadlyCrow Games
The winners of the Gamescom Dev Awards 2026 have been announced—and there are some familiar names among the newly victorious.
Wartime horror title
Mutter
took home the prize for Vocal Excellence, while acclaimed puzzler
Blue Prince
was honored with the Game Design Excellence Award. Turn-based deck-builder
Cards & Cannons
was named Most Promising Game on the night, although there's still no word on when the project from Flamehead Games will debut.
The Ambassador Award, handed out to a person chosen by the Gamescom Dev speaker community, was presented to Tencent Games business development director Amir Satvat in recognition of his efforts to support workers across the industry during a period of ongoing instability.
You can find the full list of winners below.
Gamescom dev awards 2026 – Winners
Visual Excellence Award //
MUTTER
(DeadlyCrow Games)
Most Innovative Game – powered by Epic Games //
PRAVDA(concept25)
(Floating Stone Studio)
Most Promising Game //
Cards & Cannons
(Flamehead Games)
Best Sound Design //
INVASIA
(Rocat Games)
Game Design Excellence Award – Speakers’ Choice //
Blue Prince
(Dogubomb / Raw Fury)
Ambassador Award – Speakers’ Choice //
Amir Satvat (Business Development Director at Tencent Games and founder of ASGC)
